The reference for Alternaria_Black_Molds_Stem_Cankers shows elongated conidia in chains (different morphology), but the test image shows distinctly **muriform conidia** — ovoid to oblong, multicellular with both transverse and longitudinal septa, golden-brown, with beaked tips (~20-40 μm). This is the classic microscopic signature of *Alternaria* species. Among all 19 classes, only Alternaria_Black_Molds_Stem_Cankers fits fungal conidia of this type for tomato.
